localFindings.description: stake()/unstake() have NO tail _recomputeSchedule while depositFor DOES (its 'parity with stake' comment is inaccurate -- stake has none). Benign for the depletion model (rate = budget/windowSeconds is totalStaked-independent); effect is only that depositFor re-pins windowEnd/lastRewardTime while stake does not. Inherited byte-for-byte from V1; not a regression.

emergencyWithdraw recycles forfeited pending into rewardBudget WITHOUT recomputing the schedule -- survivor over-emission class (ledger M-02, owner wont-fix on V1); present verbatim in V2. finalizeAndReset also does not recompute the schedule (rate/windowEnd stay at pre-freeze values until the next recompute trigger) -- depletion-model-acceptable but flag for interaction review since V2 is the NEW deploy target. Also inherited: _syncBudget only recomputes on inflow>0 (unlike MigrateReady's unconditional recompute) -- intended, rate is budget/window.
